notice: Interpretation of one photographed floor-plan drawing and one 61.37s handheld walkthrough video of an unfinished house. Suitable for concept design and a web prototype only. This is NOT a construction survey. All dimensions are approximate until verified against the architect's original CAD/PDF plan and an on-site measurement.

sources.description: Rotated, cropped, contrast-enhanced photograph of the architect's floor-plan drawing. Contains Hebrew room labels, printed dimension strings (centimeters), red/blue wall-segment markings of unconfirmed meaning, and a level/spot-height marker (+6.20 / 18.52).
Handheld portrait walkthrough of the unfinished house during active construction (plastered walls, incomplete floors/fixtures/joinery).
Prepared interpretation reconciling the plan and video: room list, visual observations, dimension cautions, and warm-modern-luxury design direction.
Authoritative build specification for the interactive 3D house web experience.

constraints.description: The mamad room is an Israeli protected room (MAMAD). Its door, window, ventilation, and required clearances must never be altered, obstructed, concealed, or relocated by any material variant, lighting mode, or AI-generated concept.
enforcedBy: src/data/house.ts (mamad room + its door/window carry protected: true)

constraints.description: A structural column is visible in the open social zone in the walkthrough (00:12-00:20 and 00:57-01:01). Represented as a fixed procedural column proxy in the living/kitchen/dining volume; not to be removed by furniture layout.

Wet rooms (bathroom_main, bathroom_ensuite, wc_guest) are kept clustered in their evidenced location between the private corridor and the parents' bedroom; plumbing fixtures are not relocated outside these rooms.
The entry hall / private corridor circulation spine connecting all rooms to the entry is preserved; furniture layouts must not block it.
